process_rules.reference: Preserve the audited source geometry for translation checks.
process_rules.printed: Separate hole, external-size and seam compensation parameters. Start unqualified until material, orientation and printer coupons are measured.
process_rules.cnc: Separate desired fit allowances and drawing tolerances. Use supplier-confirmed fits; tool compensation is not a universal CAD offset.
process_rules.shared: Nominal hardware, bolt circles and kinematic datums do not scale with robot size. Model expressions and interval evidence must use the same units and allowance convention.
